detail: Reproducing the loss needs a booted Android emulator, an installed sample app, and a controllable ingest latency, none of which exist inside this repository's policy worktrees. The retained evidence is the on-device before and after measurement, and validation/capsule-delivery.sh reproduces it on a machine with an emulator.
issue: Android capsule delivery raced process death on the crash path
missingCapability: a booted Android emulator inside a policy worktree
